assessmentMethod: Full-corpus metadata and existing classification screen, followed by focused relevance assessment of 42 candidate records using indexed descriptions and primary-source metadata/abstracts. This is not a systematic literature review or a full-text quality appraisal.

policy.meaning: An editorial inference linking an intervention, outcome, delivery or practice question to an existing community-specific record. It is not a finding that the candidate studied that community or that treatment effects transfer.
policy.review: New relationships remain pending Universal Mind staging review, including relationships added to previously approved papers.
policy.noNewLink: No added relation in this pass is not a finding that no related evidence exists.
policy.preservation: Existing direct, context and related matches, the original 50 human approvals and all underlying source editions remain unchanged.
